sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Geodruisge is an Irish folkloric giant. He came from County Mayo. His palace stood on Downpatrick Head, locally called Dun Geodruisge. He stole cattle from a powerful witch, who cursed him so that his palace broke from the mainland. The thieving giant then drifted out to sea.

okr.objective: Document Geodruisge as a cursed Irish giant of County Mayo.
